title: Sheet-metal enclosure
summary: from the board's size to a chassis and cover, flat patterns and bend order
description: A sheet-metal electronics case sized from what goes in it: a board, a power supply or a stack of them. Laser cut and bent from two sheets, a chassis and a cover, with the bend order proven at every change of the form.
process: Laser cutting and press-brake bending (air bending), clinch nuts pressed in, powder coating

difficulty.rationale: Two coupled press-brake parts, table-driven process data, ranges from tool geometry, bend order proven at every change.

standards: 247TailorSteel bending guidelines: die width, leg length and inner radius per thickness for CRS CR4, AlMg3 5754 H111 and AISI304L 2B
EN 485-2 (as tabulated by Metallservice and color-metal.ro): minimum bend radius of EN AW-5754 H111
Outokumpu, Forming of stainless steel: minimum inner radius of austenitic grades, r/t = 1
Fabcon, Sheet Metal DFM Guidelines: hole-to-bend distance at least 2.5 t + r
PennEngineering PEM, self-clinching nuts types CLS and SP: hole size and centre-line-to-edge distance
ISO 273 clearance holes (medium series via a published clearance table; the standard not read)
ISO 7045 pan-head screw sizes (via distributors' listings; the standard not read)
materials: Cold-rolled steel DC01, 1 to 2.5 mm, powder coated
Aluminium EN AW-5754 H111, 1 to 2.5 mm
